name: Amazon S3
shortInfo: Enable streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Amazon S3 in an automated manner
about:
Amazon Simple Storage Service is an object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance.  
  
Learn more about [Amazon S3.](https://aws.amazon.com/s3/)
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/amazon-s3/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve data from a user specified data warehouse to the Amazon S3.  
  
Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/amazon-s3/index.html) here.
